import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, pandas as pd, re, requests
seq=open("rde2_Q19672.fasta").read().split("\n",1)[1].replace("\n","")
pl=np.load("plddt.npy"); L=len(seq)
iface=[329,330,332,334,343,344,345,346,348,349,352,376,383,393,425,426,428,429,430,432,434,461,462,463,464,465,466,468,491,492,495,534,535,536,537,548,551,563,565,566,567]
comp=pd.read_csv("comparator_composition.csv").set_index("gene")

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(14,9))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(3,2,height_ratios=[1.25,1,1],hspace=.55,wspace=.25)

ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,:])
ax.plot(range(1,L+1),pl,color="#4a5568",lw=1,label="AlphaFold pLDDT (monomer, AF-Q19672-F1 v6)")
ax.axhline(70,ls="--",c="grey",lw=.8)
ax.axvspan(1,45,color="#d69e2e",alpha=.35); ax.axvspan(216,294,color="#9f7aea",alpha=.25)
ax.axvspan(297,325,color="#9f7aea",alpha=.25); ax.axvspan(326,567,color="#38a169",alpha=.14)
ax.scatter(iface,[4]*len(iface),marker="|",s=230,color="#c53030",label="contacts MUT-7 in PDB 8Q66 (<4 A)")
ax.text(23,96,"prion-like\ndomain 1-45",ha="center",fontsize=8.5,color="#744210")
ax.text(255,96,"acidic IDR\n216-294",ha="center",fontsize=8.5,color="#44337a")
ax.text(446,96,"folded MUT-7-binding CTD 326-567 (crystallised)",ha="center",fontsize=8.5,color="#22543d")
ax.set_xlim(1,L); ax.set_ylim(0,112); ax.set_ylabel("pLDDT"); ax.set_xlabel("RDE-2/MUT-8 residue")
ax.set_title("RDE-2/MUT-8 (Q19672): where the disorder is, and what actually binds MUT-7",fontsize=11)
ax.legend(fontsize=8,loc="center left")

def f(s,a): return sum(s.count(c) for c in a)/len(s)
regs={"N-PLD\n1-45":seq[:45],"acidic IDR\n216-294":seq[215:294],"acidic IDR\n297-325":seq[296:325],"CTD\n326-567":seq[325:567]}
ax2=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
x=np.arange(len(regs))
ax2.bar(x-.2,[f(s,"FWY") for s in regs.values()],.4,color="#b7791f",label="aromatic F/W/Y")
ax2.bar(x+.2,[f(s,"KR") for s in regs.values()],.4,color="#c53030",label="Lys+Arg")
ax2.set_xticks(x); ax2.set_xticklabels(regs,fontsize=8); ax2.set_ylabel("fraction")
ax2.set_title("Aromatics sit only in the PLD; no region is basic",fontsize=9.5); ax2.legend(fontsize=7.5)

ax3=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1])
ncpr=[f(s,"KR")-f(s,"DE") for s in regs.values()]
ax3.bar(x,ncpr,color=["#d69e2e","#9f7aea","#9f7aea","#38a169"])
ax3.axhline(0,c="k",lw=.7); ax3.set_xticks(x); ax3.set_xticklabels(regs,fontsize=8)
ax3.set_ylabel("NCPR"); ax3.set_title("Central IDRs are net acidic (NCPR -0.13)",fontsize=9.5)

ax4=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,0])
sub=comp.sort_values("RGG_per100",ascending=False)
ax4.bar(range(len(sub)),sub.RGG_per100,color=["#2b6cb0" if g!="rde-2" else "#c53030" for g in sub.index])
ax4.set_xticks(range(len(sub))); ax4.set_xticklabels(sub.index,rotation=70,fontsize=7.5)
ax4.set_ylabel("RGG per 100 aa"); ax4.set_title("RGG/RG boxes: RDE-2 has none",fontsize=9.5)

ax5=fig.add_subplot(gs[2,1])
sub2=comp.sort_values("KRpatch10",ascending=False)
ax5.bar(range(len(sub2)),sub2.KRpatch10,color=["#2b6cb0" if g!="rde-2" else "#c53030" for g in sub2.index])
ax5.set_xticks(range(len(sub2))); ax5.set_xticklabels(sub2.index,rotation=70,fontsize=7.5)
ax5.set_ylabel("K/R patches (>=5 of 10)"); ax5.set_title("Basic patches: RDE-2 has none",fontsize=9.5)
plt.show()
